title: quassia orinocensis
intro: Quassia orinocensis, commonly known as the South American Quassia or Yellow Quassia, is a plant species native to South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Quassia orinocensis include its use as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which helps to clear mucus from the airways, reduce swelling, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Quassia orinocensis include quassin and other limonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-parasitic activities.
